defs.epa: Expected points added per play (pass + run plays, no 2-pt tries). Offense: higher is better; defense: lower is better.
defs.sr: Success rate: share of plays with positive EPA.
defs.ypp: Yards per play: net pass yards (sacks subtracted) plus rush yards, per play.
defs.rz: Red-zone trips per game: drives that ran a play inside the opponent's 20.
defs.rztd: Red-zone TD %: share of those drives that ended in a touchdown.
defs.sk: Sack %: sacks per dropback (allowed for offense, made for defense).
defs.xpl: Explosive play rate: passes of 20+ yards and runs of 10+ yards, per play.
defs.ppy: Points per yard: scoring per yard gained (turnovers, red zone, return scores live here).
defs.splits: season = this season; l3 = last 3 games; home / away; last = last season.
defs.players: Key players: QB1 (QB2 too if QB1 is out or doubtful), top 2 RBs by carries + targets, top 4 WRs and top 2 TEs by targets over the team's last 3 games.
defs.keyinj: Key injuries: non-QB starters (60%+ of offense or defense snaps over the team's last 3 games) listed Out or Doubtful (out) or Questionable (Q) on this week's final injury report.
defs.qb: QB value: EPA per dropback for each QB (this season plus half of last season, pulled toward backup level over 150 dropbacks). If tonight's starter rates below the QB mix the team's season stats were built with, the gap times dropbacks per game is the points adjustment. The expected starter comes from the nflverse schedule.
defs.prior: A player's efficiency is pulled toward last season's rate, itself pulled toward league average (300 attempts, 350 carries, 100 targets).
